name: Integration - AzureAISearchClient.search returns only authorized document chunks
description: Verifies that AzureAISearchClient.search returns only chunks from 'Climate.pdf' and raises error if unauthorized documents are present.
input: Call AzureAISearchClient.search with a query and filter for 'Climate.pdf', mock search results to include both authorized and unauthorized documents
output: List of chunks only from 'Climate.pdf' or RuntimeError if unauthorized document is present
success_criteria: If unauthorized document is present, RuntimeError with code 'DOCUMENT_RETRIEVAL_ERROR' is raised
